general_information.Learning-Teaching Method: Inquiry-based Teaching,Experiential learning methods,Project Based Training
general_information.Description: The initial course for students to become familiar with AI problems. Through sample tutorials, students can understand the practical application of AI, how to perform step-by-step, the knowledge to equip the field of AI (computer vision, natural language processing, data science, robotics..). The Project provides students, working in groups, with a significant project experience in which they can integrate much of the material they have learned in their program, including matters relating to introduction, design, human factors, professionalism, and project management. Students will be guided to develop a software system, employing knowledge gained from courses throughout the program.
general_information.StudentTasks: # Choose appropriate project and form group. # Divide and schedule work among members. # Produce document and product according to project requirement and member work share. # Defend work infront of examination board, showing both project results and individual responsibility.
general_information.Tools: # Choose appropriate project and form group. # Divide and schedule work among members. # Produce document and product according to project requirement and member work share. # Defend work infront of examination board, showing both project results and individual responsibility.
general_information.Note: Completion Criteria (in addition to grade criteria): * Students can prove that they create the product themselves * No fatal defect in software product (the students can't demonstrate)

learning_outcomes.CLO Details: Use the knowledge of contemporary issues to identify a problem requiring technology intervention and specify the requiments for the proposed solution, algorithm.
Collect data, with consideration of techical & other factors.
Apply project management principles to software development project.
Practice oral presentation and inter-personal communications.

assessments.Note: On-going Assessment components: - Project Introduction: 5% - Project Management Plan: 5% - Review Related Works and Bibliography: 10% - Data Preparation: 10% - Methods; System Design & Implementation : 20% - Results and Discussion: 10%

assessments.Duration: ~ 30 minutes for presentation,~ 60 minutes for demo and Q&A. Total is 90 minutes.
assessments.Note: 1. Final Project Presentation components: - Documentation: 10% - Software Product: 20% - Soft Skills: 10% 2. Final Project Presentation attending criteria: * On-going Assessment Grade >=5/10 * All detailed assessment item's grades > 0/10
